subject: Temporary SOC 2 continuity confirmation request — Cedarview Health
messages:
From: Amy Liu <amy.liu@cedarview.com>
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.example.com
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: interim continuity confirmation (post-report gap)

Hi Nikhil,

We're finishing procurement for a vendor intake and need a short interim confirmation from Redwood covering the period after the SOC 2 Type II report end date. Our procurement timeline requires coverage through 2028-03-31; your most recent Type II report ends 2027-12-31.

Can you provide an interim/bridge letter or attestation confirming that there have been no material changes to the control environment relevant to security and availability since 2027-12-31, or alternatively a short statement of limited scope for the period 2028-01-01 to 2028-03-31? If possible we would also like: 
- A copy of the signed SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
- A bridge letter template (Docx/PDF) we can attach to our procurement record
- High-level evidence items: KMS key rotation cadence, backup retention policy summary, and any change controls for infra during Jan–Mar 2028.

Our auditor (copied) may ask follow-ups, but this is the minimum Sourcing asks to move the purchase to legal. Appreciate if you can expedite — target is 2028-03-18.

Thanks,
Amy Liu
Security & Compliance Lead
Cedarview Health
amy.liu@cedarview.com

Attachments: none
From: nikhil_sharma@redwood.example.com
To: irene_choi@redwood.example.com, kimberly_park@redwood.example.com
Cc: amy.liu@cedarview.com
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: interim continuity confirmation (post-report gap)

Irene / Kim — Cedarview needs a short interim/bridge letter to cover 2028-01-01 through 2028-03-31. They asked for a copy of the signed Type II report and a bridge template plus three evidence points (KMS rotation cadence, backup retention summary, change-control notes).

Can Security produce a one-page interim attestation that we can send to them and route via DocuSign? Legal may want to review but we should be able to use our standard short-form wording that affirms no material changes to security/availability controls since 2027-12-31.

Target turnaround: EOD 3/16 so we can get signature and return by 3/18.

Thanks — Nikhil
From: irene_choi@redwood.example.com
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.example.com, kimberly_park@redwood.example.com
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: interim continuity confirmation (post-report gap)

Nikhil — We have a standard interim bridge template that Legal greenlighted last quarter. I will assemble the draft and include:
- Statement of scope (security + availability)
- Reference to SOC 2 Type II report date (2027-12-31)
- A short list of evidence items (KMS rotation schedule, snapshot of backup retention policy, summary of change-control exceptions)

I will also prepare an evidence index (CSV) with links to the internal Drive bundle. If Cedarview's auditor has follow-ups we can route to Indigo Assurance (copied).

Irene
Director, Security Assurance
Redwood Inference
From: nikhil_sharma@redwood.example.com
To: Amy Liu <amy.liu@cedarview.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.example.com, kimberly_park@redwood.example.com, soc2-audit@indigoassurance.com
Date: Fri, 17 Mar 2028 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Redwood interim attestation & draft bridge letter (for Cedarview)

Hi Amy — thanks for the note and timeline. Please find below the plan and links: 

1) Attached: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027-12-31.pdf (signed report)
2) Draft interim bridge letter attached: draft_interim_bridge_letter_20280318.docx
3) Evidence index (index CSV) and Drive bundle: https://drive.redwood.example.com/cedarview/evidence-bundle-20280318
4) DocuSign link for signature-ready interim attestation: https://docusign.com/link/ABC123-cedarview-bridge (expires 7 days)

Summary of scope: We confirm that, to the best of Redwood's knowledge, there have been no material changes to the control environment affecting the security and availability principles since the report end date (2027-12-31). The interim attestation covers the window 2028-01-01 through 2028-03-31 and is intended for procurement/audit evidence only. 

Key evidence highlights included in the bundle: 
- KMS key rotation: quarterly scheduled rotation; last rotation: 2028-01-12; next scheduled: 2028-04-15
- Backup retention: encrypted backups retained for 120 days (policy excerpt attached)
- Change control: no emergency/exceptional changes to production infrastructure during Jan–Mar 2028; change log excerpt attached

If the Cedarview team or Indigo Assurance needs any additional specificity (e.g., raw change-log exports, KMS rotation certs), flag it and we will route securely.

Regards,
Nikhil Sharma
Head of Strategic Accounts (Contracting)
Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.example.com
Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027-12-31.pdf, draft_interim_bridge_letter_20280318.docx, evidence_bundle_index.csv
From: Amy Liu <amy.liu@cedarview.com>
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.example.com
Cc: soc2-audit@indigoassurance.com
Date: Sat, 18 Mar 2028 08:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood interim attestation & draft bridge letter (for Cedarview)

Nikhil — received, thank you. The materials look good overall. A couple quick asks before we finalize for procurement: 
1) In the draft attestation the backup retention line reads "retained for 90 days" — can you confirm that the policy excerpt in the evidence bundle states 120 days (we saw the 120-day excerpt)? Please correct the attestation wording to reflect 120 days if that is the canonical policy.
2) Can you add a one-line confirmation of the KMS key-rotation mechanism (automated rotation via KMS scheduler) for our auditor's checklist?

If you can update the draft and re-send DocuSign by EOD today, we'll route to Legal and Procurement and should be able to sign on Monday.

Best,
Amy
From: nikhil_sharma@redwood.example.com
To: Amy Liu <amy.liu@cedarview.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.example.com, kimberly_park@redwood.example.com, soc2-audit@indigoassurance.com

Amy — thanks, good catches. We've updated the draft to reflect 120-day backup retention and added the KMS rotation confirmation line (automated rotation via Redwood KMS scheduler; next rotation 2028-04-15). Updated draft and a refreshed DocuSign link are here: https://docusign.com/link/ABC123-cedarview-bridge-v2 (expires 7 days).

I've also attached the revised draft_interim_bridge_letter_20280318_v2.docx to our internal bundle. Please let me know if Indigo wants anything appended to the attestation text itself or if this version is OK for Legal.

Looking forward to confirmation — Nikhil
